text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- (Prime Minister) Aznar calls for two-year truce without offering concessions to opposition
- Attorneys' office studies if there were irregularities in processing accusation filed by wife of (former Banesto chairman) Conde
- (European Commission president) Santer expects deal with France to pave way for euro
EL MUNDO
- Weak opposition by (Socialist party leader) Gonzalez allows Aznar a comfortable debate
- (Former civil guard chief) Roldan testifies he contacted government before fleeing Spain
DIARIO 16
- Gloves on in State of the Nation debate
ABC
- Aznar gets full support from nationalist and calls for national consensus to achieve euro
CINCO DIAS

- This is how Health will be financed: prescription payments, according to income; tax hike on alcohol, tobacco; health spending tax rebate to disappear; insurance firms to take on medical checks for temporary incapacity
- France and EU Commission, about to reach an agreement on stability pact
- Valencia citrus exchange on road to nowhere
EXPANSION
- Aznar calls for support for austere 1998 budget
- Lain, Sacyr and Obrascon lay foundation to create sixth building firm
- Markets recover on political efforts to achieve euro
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Aznar gets Gonzalez's backing to achieve euro
- Madrid bourse re-tests 570 level
- Industry Ministry values Corporacion Siderurgica at minimum of 240 billion pesetas
- Argentaria and Santander launch offensive on (families') "fear savings"
